files.legal_basis: permission_granted (written permission held by owner, D-24; not committed)
files.window: 2026-10-07 to 2027-07-22 (school year); spans BST end 25 Oct 2026 (half-term all-day span) and BST start 28 Mar 2027 (Easter holiday span)
files.notes: Feed advertised on /100/calendar as webcal://. Content-Type has a doubled ';;' (parsers must tolerate it). VTIMEZONE Europe/London; timed events use DTSTART;TZID=Europe/London, all-day and multi-day events use VALUE=DATE with exclusive DTEND. No RRULE in events. UIDs are NOT stable: each is a row number followed by the request's Unix time (e.g. UID:2841792262071), so dedupe must key on SUMMARY + DTSTART. Most items are school-internal (term dates, mocks, parents' evenings); public ones include open evenings, presentation evenings, Children in Need.
